objective: Define mutation applicability per repository layer, distinguishing where mutation is technically valuable vs inappropriate.

scope_decision_table.rationale: Pure business logic; high test effectiveness; tests directly assert on engine outputs. mutmut 3.7.0 successfully mutates.
Pure calculation utilities; cascade mutation from engines/* implicitly tests. Direct mutation has minimal additional value.
scope_decision_table.recommended_action: INHERIT from engine mutation; no separate scope.

scope_decision_table.rationale: Service layer contains authorization, persistence, orchestration — high criticality. Currently 0-9% line coverage (M46.6). Mutation without tests is meaningless (all no-test mutants).
scope_decision_table.prerequisite: M46.14 must add tests first; mutation afterwards.

scope_decision_table.rationale: Persistence integrity is critical for financial correctness. Many repositories at 0-40% coverage.
Routers are thin orchestration layers (route → service call). Mutation testing would produce mostly equivalent mutants (param parsing, response wrapping). Contract tests provide better evidence.
scope_decision_table.recommended_action: RETAIN contract-test evidence; exclude from mutation.

scope_decision_table.rationale: Dataclasses/Pydantic models are largely declarative. Mutation produces equivalent mutants.
Mappers transform between representations — high mutation value if business semantics differ. DTOs are declarative (skip).
scope_decision_table.recommended_action: Consider mapper-only mutation in future; not in current scope.

scope_decision_table.rationale: Parsing logic for SMS/statements — high mutation value. Currently 0% coverage.
Verification framework is verified by its own tests. Mutation would be self-referential.

scope_decision_table.mutation_applicable: DEFERRED — no JS/TS mutation engine currently configured
scope_decision_table.rationale: Frontend mutation would require Stryker or similar JS/TS mutation tool. Not configured in repository. Formatters, calculations in TypeScript may benefit.
scope_decision_table.recommended_action: DEFER until JS/TS mutation infrastructure is established.

policy_decisions.decision: D-M46.8-1: Retain engines/* as authoritative mutation scope per C45.
policy_decisions.justification: C45 certified this scope; 83.6% derived score is the best current measurement.

policy_decisions.decision: D-M46.8-2: Services and repositories are NOT in the current authoritative mutation scope; coverage test (M46.14) is the right next step BEFORE mutation is attempted there.
policy_decisions.justification: Mutation without tests is meaningless. Coverage gap (M46.6) confirms need for tests first.

policy_decisions.decision: D-M46.8-3: Routers, models, dtos, db, runtime/* are NOT in mutation scope by policy.
policy_decisions.justification: Equivalent mutants would dominate; better evidence via contract/unit tests.

policy_decisions.decision: D-M46.8-4: Frontend mutation is DEFERRED until a JS/TS mutation engine is added.
policy_decisions.justification: No current infrastructure. M46.15 will assess frontend verification with available tools.

verdict: M46.8 COMPLETE. Mutation scope policy defined: engines/* authoritative; services/repositories/extraction/orchestration require test development first; routers/models/db/dtos excluded by policy; frontend deferred until JS/TS tooling added.
